definitions.short: the stout part, i.e. the fat tail of the Oriental sheep
definitions.full: H451. alyah אַלְיָה noun feminine fat tail of sheep , still accounted a delicacy in the East; (Mishna id. אַלִּיתָא אַלְיְתָה, ᵑ7, , etc.; Arabic , compare Fl TWB i. 418 a ) Exod 29:22 ; Lev 3:9 ; 7:3 ; 8:25 (all || חֵ֫לֶב ); 9:19 , probably also 1Sam 9:24 for הֶעָלֶיהָ see Gei Dr (compare Tristr Nat. Hist. Bib. ch. vi Ri HWB Schafe Smith Dict. Bib. Sheep ).
definitions.rootNote: from 422 (in the original sense of strength );
